title: Returning borrowed tables
passage:
Are you saying we should take the tables back today?
A. I’m saying we should clear them today. The truck isn’t coming until Friday.
B. Those tables were already here when I arrived.
C. That's when the truck usually brings more chairs.
passageZh:
你的意思是，我們今天應該把桌子還回去嗎？
A. 我是說今天要把桌面清空。貨車星期五才來。
B. 我到的時候那些桌子就已經在這裡了。
C. 貨車通常那時會再送些椅子來。
